The `local` plan's other kinds gate the save/restore with p-local-maybe (ir-spec 7.2, #541) -- the delete kind should take the same test.


=== DONE (s543j, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22; WIP 1 dee665db) ===

A valued tail with a modifier takes the #5001 hoist.  Probes m1 a12 a13 a23 = perl (base no).  Guard Pl/t/local-elem-02.t M7 (inverse ok).
